security.title: Sign-in security
security.subtitle: Protect your account even if someone learns your password.
security.appText: After your password, enter a code from Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Apple Passwords or any similar app.
security.passkeysText: Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or your phone, with no password. Saved in Apple Passwords, Google Password Manager or your device.
security.passkeysUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
security.passkeyAdded: Passkey added. Next time choose “Sign in with a passkey”.
security.step1: Open Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Apple Passwords on your phone.
security.step2: Scan this code (or type the key under it).
security.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
security.codesText: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you in once. Keep them somewhere safe: they are shown only now.
security.offText: Your account will be protected by the password alone.
security.codeOrRecovery: Code from the app or a recovery code
security.newCodesText: Your old recovery codes stop working. Enter a code from the app to continue.
